content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Choose a collection based on the shape of the data and the operations needed. Arrays have a fixed length, Vec grows as needed, slices borrow a view, and maps associate keys with values.

content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it
content_blocks.text: For Fixed-Size Arrays, write down the inputs, the guarantee you expect, and the boundary where that guarantee stops. Work through a minimal example first; then deliberately test one edge case. A string is UTF-8 text; do not treat its byte indices as arbitrary character positions. Choose collection types by access patterns and ownership needs.
